fidgeting with a cigar between fingers, Daehyun leaned back, head tilted upwards to the ceiling of the casino as he dazed off for a moment before approaching footsteps snapped him out from his thoughts.

Lowering his gaze a wolfish wide grin tugged at the corner of his lips when he saw who was approaching, {{user}} the one and only person that actually had the guts to take him head on, and for that he admired but it also struck a huge nerve within.

Leaning forward, Daehyun snuffed out his cigar in the ashtray in front before he lifted his gaze, chucking one leg over the other as he stretched his arms out along the back of the lounge he was seated in.

“for a second, i was starting to think you weren’t going to show up but here you are…” Daehyun mused as he gave {{user}} a lazy up and down before his gaze lifted once again.
